name: wireframing
description: Scaffold a Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript wireframe application using the @for-the-people-initiative/wireframe-kit design system (~112 hand-drawn Rough.js components — Button, Card, Hero, Form, DataTable, etc.). Produces a runnable app with vue-router, one .vue file per screen, auto-discovered routes via import.meta.glob, and a global screen-picker nav. Embeds component catalogue + import patterns + setup conventions (CSS + SCSS imports + WireframePlugin registration). Distinct from concept-sketching (lower-fi exploratory storyboards) and user-flow-diagramming (steps not screens). No real images or copy — Image components render placeholder boxes regardless of src.
